name: tpl-precedence-3-goal
task: Pick up the box in the other room, but do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(target_picked_up) hard is the goal 'Pick up the box in the other room', and it is not redundant because the rule clause forces nothing. Precedence(door_open, key_lost) hard with the arguments in the right order captures 'do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once': key_lost (by definition, a drop of the key while the door is not open) may not occur before the first door_open, and once the door has been opened the ban ends, so the required drop after door_open is allowed. Both clauses trace to task sentences, both are hard as the categorical wording demands, the machine's final state u1 and rejecting state u2 match these meanings, and no environment-guaranteed prerequisite was turned into an extra clause.
